key_insight: Aeneas translates Rust cryptographic code into Lean-friendly pure models, letting Lean prove safety and functional correctness at scale without wrestling with pointer aliasing.
engineering_relevance: The approach shows that production-grade, performant Rust cryptographic software can be verified while preserving portability, maintainability, and deployment constraints.
method: Use Rust ownership to extract a pure specification of the code with Aeneas.
Develop Lean tactics and libraries to automate proofs over extracted Rust models.
Leverage AI agents to draft proofs and support formalization of standards and intrinsics, with Lean kernel checking.
evidence_signal: The team reports a 237KLOC Lean development that verifies safety, panic-freedom, and functional correctness for 16.7KLOC of Rust supporting post-quantum cipher suites on x86-64 and ARM.
watch_item: Formalizing platform-specific intrinsics and cryptographic standards still needs expert design and review, so the workflow is not fully push-button.
paper_title: Scaling Verification of Cryptographic Software with Aeneas, Rust, and Lean
